headline: Nigerian Stocks Plunge as Investors Liquidate Ahead of Dangote Refinery Debut
summary: Nigerian stocks suffered heavy losses, wiping 7 trillion naira off market capitalization as institutional and retail investors liquidated portfolios ahead of the Dangote Refinery's market debut.
why: The Nigerian Exchange hosts major African equities, and large portfolio rebalancing events can trigger temporary market-wide sell-offs.

impacts.name: Nigerian Exchange All-Share Index
impacts.why: Broad market liquidation directly depresses local equity index valuations.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Heavy profit-taking and capital reallocation by investors preparing for a major public listing triggered broad-based selling across local equities.
